title: Compass Glow
generation_prompt: Produce one ORIGINAL 128-second stereo MELODIC TRANCE instrumental for an all-ages one-or-two-key rhythm game at STRICT constant 139 BPM in 4/4. The recording begins INSIDE THE FULL CHORUS GROOVE at time zero: strong clean kick on every quarter beat, crisp clap on beats two and four, eighth-note hats, short bright plucked arpeggio attacks on every quarter beat, rounded bass and wide warm chord pads all clearly present at steady volume to the final beat. No ambient intro, slow build, drumless break, half-time switch, quiet passage, fade, filtered outro, silence or tempo drift. Signature hook: four-note arpeggio points upward, pauses for an eighth-note rest, then a two-note lower reply returns to the center; make all note edges crisp and chartable. At 64 seconds retain the exact kick/clap grid and volume, change bass roots, pivot the four-note hook downwards and answer from a new higher register, varying until the last beat. Bright, hopeful, flowing without shrill highs or a generic festival drop. No vocals, speech, samples, known melody or imitation of another song.
cover_prompt: Create one original SQUARE 1:1 duohertz cover for Compass Glow, an uplifting all-ages trance rhythm-game track. Original high-contrast editorial comic-print cut-paper style: near-black ink, warm ivory, electric cyan, coral red, restrained halftone. Main motif: ONE large FOUR-POINT warm-ivory COMPASS ROSE made of four long sharp paper triangles around a small empty black center, with the top point longer than the others. ONE cyan soundline travels vertically through the center, bends once and exits near the top point; exactly two coral short beat dashes mark its crossing and one tiny warm-yellow dot sits in the center. No circular ring. Keep the entire compass within the central 55% of the square for a narrow 100px mobile crop, dark lower fifth for local title overlay. Flat bold print, distinct from stars in space, arrows, sailboats, prisms and city signs. No scenery, people, words, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, strobe or copied game art.
og_prompt: Edit the supplied original Compass Glow square cover into a HORIZONTAL roughly 1.9:1 duohertz social card. Preserve ONE four-point warm-ivory cut-paper compass rose with longer north point, one cyan soundline passing through the center and bending once, exactly two coral beat dashes and one tiny yellow central dot; do not add a ring. Recompose the complete compass on the RIGHT half over near-black editorial comic-print ink with restrained halftone, leaving dark space on the LEFT. Add exactly two crisp fully legible English lines at left: 'duohertz' lowercase electric cyan and 'Compass Glow' larger warm ivory. Spell both exactly without truncation. Purpose-build wide composition, do not stretch square. No other text, numbers, scenery, people, logos, watermark or copied game art.
